description:
> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md §6.*

In the podman arm64 VM (8 GiB), mix test test/agreement_test.exs --seed 5 aborted the node natively: binary_alloc: Cannot allocate 8589934592 bytes. Elixir mode builds <<0::size(n*esz)-unit(8)>> for any size below 2^47, so a generated size can exhaust the host. Under Valgrind the whole file was OOM-killed at 7.5 GB after a 4 GiB block. Decide: bound generated sizes in the properties, and/or have Elixir mode raise above a sane limit (both modes must agree).

comments.text: Decision (maintainer, 2026-10-13): do both — bound the sizes the agreement properties generate, AND add one size limit that Elixir mode and native mode both enforce (raise above it, same error in both modes).

title: agreement_test can abort the VM: Elixir mode builds multi-GiB zero binaries (seed 5 on an 8 GiB host: binary_alloc cannot allocate 8589934592 bytes)
